identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit, 'Eat Learn Play Foundation', EIN 83-1373602, Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer)
Foundation's website says it has remodeled six gymnasiums across Oakland Unified School District schools, matching the agenda's 'Donated Gymnasium Improvements' item
Under Armour's own site describes a partnership with the Eat. Learn. Play. Foundation to revitalize youth sports in Oakland, explaining the 'Under Armour (UA)' part of the agenda name
research.notes: Agenda names the vendor with 'Under Armour (UA)' as a partner/donor prefix; the legal entity is the Eat Learn Play Foundation. The foundation's website shows no general phone, email or mailing address (only a media email at a PR agency), so those are left null.

profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, founded in 2019 by Stephen and Ayesha Curry. It works on children's wellbeing in Oakland through three areas: providing nutritious meals, supporting early literacy, and creating spaces for physical activity, including remodeled schoolyards and gymnasiums.

sources.title: Eat Learn Play Foundation - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The agenda name contains 'Eat.Learn.Play. Foundation' and the item is donated gymnasium improvements; ProPublica confirms the Oakland 501(c)(3) (EIN 83-1373602), and the foundation site confirms 2019 founding by Stephen and Ayesha Curry, the eat/learn/play pillars, and six remodeled gymnasiums in Oakland. The Under Armour partnership claim could not be independently verified, but the summary does not rely on it.
